text:
Lodash is bumped to 4.17.21, but the tests don't pass: 3 fail in `src/utils/date-utils.spec.js` ("formats DST boundary in America/New_York", "parses local midnight", "rolls over month end in local tz"). I haven't confirmed whether the bump caused them.

My "before" run isn't a valid baseline. `git stash` only reverts `package.json` and the lockfile, and `node_modules` still held 4.17.21. The environment also reports this directory isn't a git repo, so the stash may not have done anything at all. Both runs likely used the same lodash.

The failures are all timezone-related, and lodash has no date functions, so I suspect an existing dependence on the machine's timezone. That is an inference, not a finding.

To settle it, run `npm install lodash@4.17.15 && npm test -- date-utils`, then repeat with `TZ=America/New_York`. If the failures persist on 4.17.15 and vanish under that TZ, the bump is not the cause.

I also didn't check whether a version newer than 4.17.21 exists. Check `package.json` to confirm the stash pop restored the bump.
